description: This file contains client-side scripts for managing stock entry forms in ERPNext, including setup, validation, UI interactions, and data fetching for stock transactions.

classes.name: erpnext.stock.StockEntry
classes.description: A class extending StockController to handle stock entry operations, setup, validation, and UI interactions.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initial setup for the stock entry form, including query configurations and data fetching.

methods.name: setup_quality_inspection
methods.description: Configures quality inspection options and related queries.

methods.name: outgoing_stock_entry
methods.description: Sets items for stock in based on outgoing stock entry.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the form, updates UI elements, and adds custom buttons based on document status.

methods.name: scan_barcode
methods.description: Initiates barcode scanning for stock items.

methods.name: on_submit
methods.description: Handles actions after form submission.

methods.name: after_cancel
methods.description: Handles actions after canceling the form.

methods.name: set_default_account
methods.description: Sets default expense account based on company settings.

methods.name: clean_up
methods.description: Removes related local data when cleaning up the form.

methods.name: fg_completed_qty
methods.description: Fetches items based on finished goods quantity.

methods.name: get_items
methods.description: Retrieves stock items based on BOM and manufacturing quantity.

methods.name: work_order
methods.description: Fetches work order details and related stock items.

methods.name: toggle_enable_bom
methods.description: Enables or disables BOM field based on context.

methods.name: add_excise_button
methods.description: Adds an excise invoice button for India.

methods.name: items_add
methods.description: Copies expense account and cost center to new item rows.

methods.name: from_warehouse
methods.description: Sets warehouse details for source warehouse.

methods.name: to_warehouse
methods.description: Sets warehouse details for target warehouse.

methods.name: set_warehouse_in_children
methods.description: Assigns warehouse info to child table rows.

methods.name: items_on_form_rendered
methods.description: Initializes serial or batch number setup on form render.

methods.name: toggle_related_fields
methods.description: Enables/disables form fields based on purpose.

methods.name: supplier
methods.description: Fetches supplier details.

methods.name: set_serial_no
methods.description: Fetches and sets serial number for an item.

methods.name: make_retention_stock_entry
methods.description: Creates a retention stock entry for samples.

methods.name: toggle_display_account_head
methods.description: Shows or hides account head columns based on inventory settings.

methods.name: set_basic_rate
methods.description: Calculates and sets basic rate for an item.

methods.name: get_warehouse_details
methods.description: Fetches warehouse details for an item.

methods.name: show_bom_custom_button
methods.description: Displays BOM button based on purpose and status.

methods.name: get_items_from_bom
methods.description: Opens dialog to fetch items from BOM.

methods.name: calculate_basic_amount
methods.description: Calculates basic amount for an item.

methods.name: calculate_total_additional_costs
methods.description: Sums up total additional costs.

methods.name: source_warehouse_address
methods.description: Displays source warehouse address.

methods.name: target_warehouse_address
methods.description: Displays target warehouse address.

methods.name: add_to_transit
methods.description: Handles adding a warehouse to transit.

methods.name: set_transit_warehouse
methods.description: Sets default transit warehouse.

methods.name: apply_putaway_rule
methods.description: Applies putaway rules if enabled.
